reason: Reproduced: on home.balance-table the Balance table button is the selected segment and carries tabindex=-1, so Tab skips it. The only other segment, Balance graph, is in the tab order. Enter on it switches the view and the roles swap, so a keyboard user can reach both views, and Space on the already-selected button changed nothing.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 Keyboard needs every function to work from the keyboard. The skipped button is the segment already showing, and activating it does nothing (Space left the view unchanged). Showing the table, the only function it ever has, is reachable by Tab then Enter from the graph view, and the view toggles both ways with focus kept on the pressed button. 2.4.3 holds because the order stays logical. 4.1.2 (whether a selected segment exposes its state) is a different claim from the one this finding makes and was not tested here. No A or AA criterion fails on keyboard reach.
